name: Pierce Magical Protection (Combat)
body:
You can pierce straight through any spells your target attempts to put in place to protect them.

Prerequisite(s): Mage Slayer, base attack bonus +9.

Benefit: You may disregard AC bonuses granted by magic items, spells or spell-like abilities such as a ring of protection, mage armor or barkskin. You may not negate the effects of a spell, item or effect with a caster level of your character level +4.
